name: TubeCLI
summary: Self-hosted open-source AI agent team that makes videos, drives browsers, deploys sites and runs tasks.
use_cases: deploy a website to Cloudflare Workers from one sentence
extract and translate video subtitles to SRT/VTT/ASS
automate real browsers with profiles and live view
approve AI-created tasks before irreversible actions

what_it_does.quote: TubeCLI is a self-hosted, open-source AI agent team that executes real operational work end to end.

who_it_is_for.quote: on your machine, with your keys, for your clients.

prerequisites.quote:
#### Prerequisites
- Python 3.10+
- Git
- Node.js 18+ and ffmpeg

config_and_keys.quote: No. Point it at local [Ollama](https://ollama.com) and it runs with no API key and no per-token cost.

troubleshooting_uninstall.quote: To remove it: tray icon → Quit, then delete `~/TubeCLI` (Windows) or `~/tubecli` and the config folder.

license_and_platforms.quote: TubeCLI is MIT: multi-tenant deployment, white-labelling and reselling are all permitted.
